section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the main sample of a study conducted at a university in Romania, consisting of 212 female and 241 male undergraduate and graduate students (total N=453). Participants ranged in age from 17 to 61 years (M=23.57), with a mean self-reported BMI of 22.18 kg/m², and 88.3% were enrolled in college or higher education programs. The majority identified as Romanian ethnicity (97.3%) and Eastern Orthodox (68.1%).
